title: An Agentic AI Workflow for Liver Lesion Segmentation and Structured Radiology Reporting
abstract: arXiv:2610.34599v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite advances in automated liver lesion segmentation, a gap remains between image-derived predictions and clinically interpretable radiology reports. Bridging this gap requires quantitative measurements that are both reproducible and traceable. We present an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that connects liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and structured reporting. TotalSegmentator-based nnU-Net models delineate the liver, Couinaud segments, and lesions, while computational tools extract volumes, dimensions, counts, and anatomical locations. A large language model (LLM) organizes these measurements into a predefined reporting schema, with numerical consistency checks against source measurements. On 51 LiTS cases, the segmentation stage achieved a liver Dice score of 0.947, lesion sensitivity of 75.6%, and positive predictive value of 68.9%. translated_title: 一种用于肝脏病灶分割与结构化放射学报告的智能体AI工作流
translated_abstract: 尽管自动化肝脏病灶分割技术不断进步，但图像衍生的预测结果与临床可解读的放射学报告之间仍存在差距。弥合这一差距需要既可重复又可追溯的定量测量。我们提出了一种基于证据的智能体AI框架，将肝脏和病灶分割与确定性定量分析及结构化报告相连接。基于TotalSegmentator的nnU-Net模型用于描绘肝脏、Couinaud肝段和病灶，同时计算工具提取体积、尺寸、数量和解剖位置等信息。大语言模型（LLM）将这些测量数据整理成预定义的报告模板，并对照原始测量数据进行数值一致性检查。在51例LiTS病例上，分割阶段实现了肝脏Dice系数0.947、病灶灵敏度75.6%和阳性预测值68.9%。对25,494份MERLIN报告的探索性筛查识别出1……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于证据的智能体AI框架，将肝脏及病灶自动分割、确定性定量测量与大语言模型驱动的结构化放射学报告相结合，实现了可重复且可追溯的自动化影像报告生成。
en_tdlr: The paper presents an evidence-grounded agentic AI framework that integrates liver and lesion segmentation with deterministic quantification and LLM-driven structured radiology reporting, enabling reproducible and traceable automated report generation.
